ModMetaData.name: The Dead Man's Switch - Legion
ModMetaData.description:
一支新的殖民舰队前锋抵达了边缘世界，并展开了新一代作战体系部署。他们带来了全新的机兵、装备、载具，以及——全新的空中支援体系。

本MOD是对失能机关本体及其部分附属内容的综合拓展，包括：

21个全新机兵
包含15种中型、1种轻型无人机以及5种超重型型号。各单位承担不同战术角色，涵盖从后勤支持到正面压制的多种战术定位，可形成结构完整的军团体系。超重型机兵需要加载The Dead Man's Switch - AncientCorps。

新叙事者：艾丽萨
来自武装殖民舰队的军官。她以临机决断推动局势发展，事件节奏偏随机，但更倾向于舰队相关互动与直接威胁。
在她看来，机兵部队是舰队体系的延伸。维持并扩充机兵编制，更容易获得她的认可。

新叙事者：拉斐尔
一位温和的人工智能。她的故事稳定而规律，两个事件之间将有充裕的休整时间。她更乐于给予你选择空间，让你自主处理各种任务，并在危难关头伸出援手。

空中支援系统
全新的空中支援系统——与武装殖民舰队成为盟友，在通讯台呼叫多种空中支援，以争取优势甚至扭转战局。如果权限足够，甚至能调用武装殖民舰队的核打击系统……
但要当心，你的部分敌人同样拥有呼叫空中支援的能力……

一款全新载具
“灰骑士”——重型通用底盘，支持通过更换不同炮塔实现不同战术定位。需要加载The Dead Man's Switch - Motorized。

除此之外，还增添了两种功能性建筑、两套全新衣物、两个拥有特殊功能的装备以及七款全新武器。

总策划/美工/XML：Silver
主程序：星羽枝繁
封面/叙事者：数据删除
CE：白金trigger


A new vanguard force of the Colonial Fleet has arrived in the Rim, deploying a next-generation combat system. They bring brand-new mech units, equipment, vehicles, and most importantly — a brand-new aerial support system.

This mod is a comprehensive expansion for The Dead Man's Switch core and several of its addons, including:

21 brand-new mech units
Including 15 medium models, 1 light drone unit, and 5 ultra-heavy models. Each unit fulfills a distinct tactical role, ranging from logistical support to frontline suppression, forming a complete and structured legion combat system. Ultra-heavy mechs require The Dead Man's Switch - AncientCorps.

New storyteller: Elisa
An officer from the Armed Colonial Fleet. She drives the situation forward through tactical judgment. Her pacing is somewhat unpredictable, but she favors fleet-related interactions and direct threats.
In her view, mech forces are an extension of the Fleet system. Maintaining and expanding your mech roster will earn her approval more easily.

New storyteller: Raphael
A gentle artificial intelligence. Her stories are steady and predictable, with ample time to recover between events. She prefers to give you room to make your own choices, allowing you to approach various tasks freely while offering support in times of crisis.

Aerial support system
A brand-new aerial support system — become allies with the Armed Colonial Fleet and call in multiple types of aerial support via the comms console to gain an advantage or even turn the tide of battle. With sufficient authorization, you may even gain access to the Armed Colonial Fleet's nuclear strike system……
But be careful — some of your enemies are also capable of calling in aerial support……

A brand-new vehicle
"Gray Knight" — a heavy universal chassis capable of adapting to different tactical roles through interchangeable turrets. Requires The Dead Man's Switch - Motorized.

In addition, this mod also adds two new functional buildings, two new apparel sets, two special-function pieces of equipment, and seven brand-new weapons.
